download_bst_single_task_model: download the pretrained BlendedSkillTalk single task polyencoder retrieval model to the specified datapath
review_download_function: review the download function that fetches the BST single task model using Parlai's download_models utility
summarize_bst_module: summarize the BST single task module that provides model download for the BlendedSkillTalk dialogue task
run_download_bst_model: run the download function to retrieve the v1.0 BST single task model tarball into the blended_skill_talk folder
test_download_bst: test the download function by calling it with a valid datapath to verify model retrieval
